deploy-bot: TF APPLY STARTED — env=prod-dc5, triggered_by=@carla, commit=0a1b2c3d, tag=release-v1.6.8
deploy-bot: plan summary: +4 resources (aws_instance.gpu_node), ~0 to destroy, 2 to update. plan link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4553
carla: copying plan, running quick health checks before we let it finish. will monitor logs. :eyes:
jesse: locking route tables and scaling alarms in case of sudden spike. ping me if anything unusual.
deploy-bot: APPLY IN PROGRESS — applying module.gpupool (step 3/5)
infra-oncall: FYI saw elevated quota warnings earlier in dc5, if we hit quota apply may partially succeed. watch for related errors.
deploy-bot: APPLY COMPLETE — success. outputs: gpupool_size=16, instance_ids=[i-0a1, i-0b2, i-0c3]. plan run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4553#apply
anita: quick smoke: hopped into two new nodes, scheduler failing to register pods on i-0b2 and i-0c3, logs show nv_peer_mem errors. not confident to keep this for production traffic. :exclamation:
carla: can you paste the scheduler logs? if it's an incompat with driver we should rollback to release-v1.6.7.
anita: ```
[ERROR] nv_peer_mem: initialization failed: missing kernel module
[WARN] kubelet: failed to register device plugin
```
carla: ok. decision: rolling back gpupool resize to previous stable commit (0f9e8d). tagging rollback-release-v1.6.7. will trigger tf apply revert.
jesse: +1 on rollback. I'll keep the alarms muted while revert runs. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: TF APPLY STARTED (rollback) — env=prod-dc5, triggered_by=@carla, revert_to_commit=0f9e8d, reason="driver incompat after resize"
deploy-bot: plan summary (rollback): -4 resources (remove aws_instance.gpu_node), 0 to add, will restore gpupool_size=12. plan link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4554
deploy-bot: APPLY COMPLETE — rollback success. outputs: gpupool_size=12, removed_instance_ids=[i-0b2, i-0c3, i-0d4, i-0e5]. run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4554#apply
carla: thanks everyone. follow-up ticket created for kernel/driver checks and preflight validation: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-712
infra-oncall: noted, will update runbooks to include kernel module check before future gpupool resizes.
jesse: re-enable alarms and confirm steady metrics in the next 15m.
anita: will re-run smoke tests and post a short verification report.
carla: closing thread — rolling back prevented user-facing impact. :white_check_mark:
